quality.dispersion_threshold_rationale: The 400 m threshold equals the smallest fixed commercial-evidence proximity band, so a wider exit set can materially change exit-union buffer evidence. It is a review trigger, never a grouping rule.
quality.grouping_method: Exact case/whitespace-normalized S005 station name; no fuzzy or distance-based merge/split. Authoritative station overrides are applied before grouping, never by proximity alone.
